title: DPE-Rec: Diversity-Preserving and Efficient Diffusion Language Model Recommendation for Bundle Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.34700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative bundle construction completes a partially observed bundle by generating its missing items from a large product catalog. Compared to autoregressive LLMs, diffusion LLM emerges as a natural fit for this unordered generation task. Their bidirectional attention provides an inductive bias better aligned with unordered bundle construction. Iterative denoising can reveal multiple tokens per step, potentially reducing inference latency. However, directly applying DLMs to this task presents two key challenges: 1 Despite its flexible reveal order, confidence-guided decoding tends to postpone semantic-fork decisions until refinement tokens constrain their choices, reducing bundle diversity. 2 Revealing more tokens per step can compromise recommendation quality, stifling the potential for faster inference. translated_title: DPE-Rec：面向捆绑包构建的多样性保持且高效的扩散语言模型推荐
translated_abstract: 生成式捆绑包构建通过从大型商品目录中生成缺失的商品来完成部分观测到的捆绑包。与自回归大语言模型相比，扩散大语言模型（DLM）天然适合这种无序生成任务。其双向注意力提供了一种与无序捆绑包构建更加契合的归纳偏置；迭代去噪可以每步揭示多个词元，有望降低推理延迟。然而，直接将扩散语言模型应用于该任务存在两个关键挑战：1）尽管揭示顺序灵活，但基于置信度引导的解码往往会推迟“语义分叉”决策，直到精化词元限制了其选择空间，从而降低捆绑包的多样性；2）每步揭示更多词元可能损害推荐质量，抑制更快推理的潜力。我们提出了DPE-Rec，一个实现多样性保持与高效推荐的扩散框架。DPE-Rec通过…（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出DPE-Rec扩散语言模型推荐框架，通过解决置信度解码导致的语义分叉决策延迟和多词元并行解码的质量下降问题，在保持捆绑包多样性的同时实现高效推理。
en_tdlr: DPE-Rec is a diffusion language model framework for bundle construction that preserves bundle diversity and achieves efficient recommendation by tackling semantic-fork decision delays in confidence-guided decoding and quality degradation in parallel multi-token revealing.
